How it works

From your list to your door in four steps

You bring the request. We handle the suppliers, the checking and the shipping.

  1. Tell us what you want

    Send the product, quantity and the price you have in mind. Photos and links help.

  2. We source it

    We buy directly from factories at factory price, based on what you asked for.

  3. We check it in person

    Your goods reach our China warehouse partner, where our colleague inspects them before anything ships.

  4. We ship to Ghana

    Choose air or sea. Your goods travel to Ghana, mainly through Tema, and we coordinate delivery.

Shipping

Air or sea, your choice

Pick the speed that suits your goods and your budget. We quote freight for each order.

Fast by air, economical by sea

Air freight suits urgent or smaller orders, with express delivery in 1–3 days. Sea cargo takes 30–45 days and suits larger, heavier orders when cost matters more than speed.

Tell us what you are buying and we will suggest the better fit.

Quality control

Someone we trust looks at your goods first

Buying from abroad means trusting photos. Before your order leaves China, our colleague inspects the products in person, so you find out about problems before they cross the ocean.

Pricing

One clear fee

10%of product cost

We buy at factory price and add a 10% service fee on the total product cost. Freight is paid on top, based on the shipping option you choose.

  • Factory price for your products
  • Sourcing, checking and coordination included in the fee
